checks.name: Backup Encryption at Rest & In-Transit
checks.details: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit verified compliant across all backup endpoints.

checks.name: Immutable WORM Object Locking
checks.details: Write-Once-Read-Many lock enabled on backup vault, preventing unauthorized modification or ransomware deletion.

checks.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement
checks.details: Principle of least privilege strictly enforced; non-DR users cannot access backup archives.

checks.name: Tamper-Evident Signature Verification
checks.details: SHA-256 signed manifests and continuous integrity scans guarantee tamper-proof backup preservation.

summary: Backup security verified: AES-256 encryption, TLS 1.3, WORM immutability locks, and RBAC active.

security_controls.implementation: All database snapshots and storage mirrors encrypted with customer-managed KMS key
All replication traffic and backup transfers enforced over TLS 1.3 with cipher restrictions
Object lock compliance mode active; backup deletion and overwrites blocked for 90 days
Restoration privileges restricted to automated DR service account and emergency SRE break-glass
Automated cryptographic signature validation on backup manifest triggers immediate alert on modification
